description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to WebSocket protocol handling within a web framework. It includes the 'Protocol' class for WebSocket frame management, 'WebSocketLinkType' for managing WebSocket connections, upgrades, and message serialization/deserialization, as well as client-side handling through 'WebSocketClientType'. It provides mechanisms for upgrading HTTP connections to WebSocket, sending and receiving data frames, and handling control messages like PING/PONG and CLOSE.

classes.name: Protocol
classes.description: Manages WebSocket protocol specifics such as frame types, masking, encoding/decoding, and request/response key generation.

classes.name: RequestAllocator
classes.description: Provides a pooled allocator for Web::Request objects.

classes.name: ResponseAllocator
classes.description: Provides a pooled allocator for Web::Response objects.

classes.name: WebSocketLinkType
classes.description: Handles WebSocket connection states, message serialization/deserialization, connection upgrades, and data transfer.

classes.name: WebSocketClientType
classes.description: Client-side manager for WebSocket connections, facilitating connection setup, state management, and message exchange.

classes.name: HandlerType (nested within WebSocketLinkType)
classes.description: Template class managing individual WebSocket handler instances, including upgrade processes and frame handling.

classes.name: SerializerImpl (nested within WebSocketLinkType::HandlerType)
classes.description: Serializes outbound messages for WebSocket transmission.

classes.name: DeserializerImpl (nested within WebSocketLinkType::HandlerType)
classes.description: Deserializes inbound messages from WebSocket frames.

classes.name: Handler
classes.description: Template class managing per-connection WebSocket links, encapsulating methods for sending and receiving data, handling state changes, and connection signals.

methods.name: RequestKey
methods.description: Generates a WebSocket request key for handshake.

methods.name: ResponseKey
methods.description: Computes the WebSocket acceptance key from a request key.

methods.name: Encoder
methods.description: Encodes WebSocket data frames with masking and framing.

methods.name: Decoder
methods.description: Decodes incoming WebSocket frames, extracting payload data and handling control frames.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Sends data over WebSocket, framing as necessary.
